blocks.x: Uh could you talk about your um, your stints working with uh, with Barry Harris?

Oh, yes. Barry Harris is, is respected, highly respected, particularly in Detroit when we were all there, they called him the “high priest of music.” Um...he taught uh the saxophonist Charles McPherson, from about age 13 somewhere, and Lonnie Hilliyer. He’s a very wise man. In fact, I think I learned more about autophysiopsychic music
from Barry than other one person, and he’s, he’s a world teacher right today. I respect him highly.
Yeah, another of that great Detroit connection.
I like his album with, with Sonny Stitt and, and your father, Katya. He played uh, I like that uh Can’t Get Started With You. That’s a beautiful album.
